S2a2_linear_P_minus_rhobar_xi.detail: P = -rhobar xi + (divergence-free) at linear order, xi = x - phi (sign: div P = +delta rho)

S2b_tether_is_minimal_gravitational_coup.detail: -delta rho_c Phi = P.grad Phi - div(P Phi) with div P = delta rho_c; -|grad Phi - KP|^2/2K - W_rem = -|grad Phi|^2/2K + P.grad Phi - W_full; the medium's rest-mass coupling gives -rho Phi (K3): FORCED

S2b2_W_identities.detail: K W_full' = u/(1 - u/a0), K W_rem' = u^2/(a0 - u), D_full = u + R

S2c_W_not_a_strain_or_local_function.detail: uniform compression phi = x/lambda: B = delta/lambda^2 everywhere but |P|^2 = (lambda**3 - 1)**2*(x**2 + y**2 + z**2)/(9*lambda**6) grows with position; two profiles identical near R with different interiors: u differs by pi*Delta*G*R/6 -> u is an enclosed-mass (nonlocal) quantity; a local covariant W(K|P|) needs an extra structure

S2c2_chi_constraint_gives_u.detail: D^2 chi = K rho_c (medium frame) -> chi' = G M_c(<r)/r^2 = u = K|P_L| (Gauss)

S2d_stiffness_is_density_squared.detail: |d_i d_j chi|^2 = (lap chi)^2 + divergence (3-D, exact); with K P_L = grad chi: (gamma/2)|grad P_L|^2 = (gamma/2) delta rho_c^2 + divergence; traceless form (3 gamma/4K^2) tau^2 gives the same (2/3 factor absorbed)

S2d2_static_equation_with_stiffness.detail: EL: D_full(u) = g + gamma d rho_c/dr, i.e. R(u) = g_N + gamma rho_c' (stiffness = pressure p = (gamma/2) rho_c^2 = pi G L*^2 rho_c^2; rho_c' < 0 pushes u below the law: screening)

S2d3_local_stiffness_EoS_early_universe.detail: computed (a result, not a pass line): the LOCAL covariant stiffness is a stiff EoS; EXCLUDED at BBN for the whole L* window if the medium exists then (ratio >> 0.1); the chi-tidal (traceless) form vanishes on FRW (S1d) and has no background

S3a_tether_sector_stress_by_metric_varia.detail: T_ij = (W'/u) d_i chi d_j chi - delta_ij W + 2 d_(i lambda d_j) chi - delta_ij grad lambda.grad chi

S3c_static_stress_equals_CFG660_Pi.detail: p_r = -W_full(u), p_t = p_r + D(u) u/K; on the law: dP_par/dg = (g/K)(dg_N/dg - 1), P_perp - P_par = g(g - g_N)/K, deep P_par = -g**2/(8*pi*G) + g**3/(6*pi*G*a_0); radial balance p_r' + 2(p_r - p_t)/r = -rho_c g. CFG660's stress is the derived stress of this action

S3d_drift_is_linearised_tether_force.detail: f = D(u) - g = R(u) - g_N ~ R'(u_L)(u - u_L) = R'(u_L)(g - g_law): same direction as CFG638/CFG544 v_s = alpha tau (g - g_law); an overdamped limit needs a drag (mobility tau_d: alpha tau = tau_d R'(u_L)), which the ideal action does not contain

S3e_settling_energy_books_close_with_tet.detail: pushing a central surplus out raises the gravitational energy (CFG932's injection) but releases more tether energy W; total potential energy falls, the difference is dissipated (heat). S5a_dispersion_relation.detail: omega^2 = c_s^2 k^2 + K rho0 [R'(u0) cos^2 theta + (R(u0)/u0) sin^2 theta], c_s^2 = gamma rho0; self-gravity (-K rho0) cancelled and over-cancelled by the tether; transverse (vortical) roots omega^2 = 0

S5b_no_gradient_instability_bounded_grow.detail: omega^2 >= 0 for every k and angle (gamma > 0, 0 <= u0 < a0): no growth at all, versus CFG660's growth proportional to sqrt(k)

S5c_positive_inertia_condition.detail: kinetic matrix positive iff rho_c c^2 > D(u) u/K (the tether stress); margin ~ c^2/v^2 on the law; screened regions (u ~ K rho_c r/3) need only r < 3c/sqrt(K rho_c). CONDITION, not automatic

S5d_chi_lambda_non_propagating.detail: in the medium rest frame the chi/lambda sector has no time derivatives: constraints (elliptic, instantaneous in that frame); propagating dof = medium (1 longitudinal at c_s, 2 vortical at 0) + graviton (2)

S6_growth_flag_computed.detail: a result, not a pass line: the covariant parent of S2 + ID suppresses linear growth of the tethered medium; the record's growth pass (T2x, class A) does NOT transfer to this parent. Before recombination the medium would follow photon-locked baryons only
